item.title: Facing Water Shortages, These Sundarbans Farmers Turned Their Fields into Lifesaving Ponds
item.description: In May 2024, farmers in Jeliakhali gave up parts of their farmland. They dug into their fields to create ponds that could hold rainwater, a decision shaped by years of watching water arrive with the monsoon and fade soon after. The ponds were meant to store rain for irrigation and reduce pressure on drinking water sources once the dry months set in. This experience reflects a larger reality across the Indian Sundarbans. item.title: Before Podcasts, Remembering How Radios Shaped Our Mornings Two Decades Ago
item.description: “You are listening to 91.9 FM…” (buzz… crackle…) “…today’s headlines…” (another buzz, and suddenly, a song from a 90s film begins to play). And there she stops tuning.
